About Me:

I'm Chris — a full-stack web developer based in New York City who enjoys turning messy, real-world problems into clean, thoughtful web experiences.

Most of my work centers around React, Next.js, and TypeScript — building data-driven tools like fantasy sports optimizers, smarter fitness tracking, and utilities for the Pokémon TCG. I care a lot about clear UX, performance, and writing code that's easy for the next developer to understand.

Right now I'm sharpening my back-end skills with Node, APIs, and MongoDB, and growing into a role where I can ship production features, learn from more senior engineers, and contribute to a strong engineering culture.

{/* LEFT BOX */}

Problems I'm Solving

  • Shipping small, end-to-end features in real projects
  • Deepening my TypeScript and testing habits
  • Designing clean, predictable API contracts
  • Leveling up in performance, accessibility, and DX
{/* RIGHT BOX */}

Tech I Work With

React
Next.js
TypeScript
JavaScript
Node.js
MongoDB
CSS / SCSS
REST APIs

Outside of coding, you'll usually find me competing in the Pokémon TCG, teaching chess to elementary school students, lifting, or finding new things to learn that mix strategy, iteration, and long-term improvement.
